FUNCTION FIND_DIVISORS ACCEPTS(n)
  divisors <- EMPTY LIST
  FOR i FROM 1 TO n
    IF n MOD i == 0 THEN
      divisors <- divisors + [i]
    END IF
  END FOR
  RETURN divisors
END FUNCTION
